text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'dedi-east-1' near 100% GPU reservation utilization (reserved tenants impacted) — queue depth rising, autoscaler failing to provision new nodes. Pager triggered. :rotating_light:

sara (oncall): seeing spike in reserved queue, VelvetPay requests piling up, customers reporting 429s/timeout. taking pager.

marco (infra): +1. autoscaler logs show repeated failures from cloud API: `QuotaExceeded` then `InstanceProvisionPending` stuck >5m. suspect regional capacity + cloud quota enforcement.

jess (sre): can we soft-evict low-priority sessions and drain prefix cache to free kv memory? prioritize enterprise reservations.

marco (infra): kicking off soft-eviction job now: `./tools/evict --pool dedi-east-1 --priority low --dry-run=false`

ops-bot: evict job started (job-id: evict-1791999999) — evicting ~120 sessions from low-priority buckets. progress: 0/120

ops-bot: progress update: 80/120 evicted, queue depth down ~25%

aliya (cs): Velv etPay on a call? I pinged their TAM and created a customer bridge. they see high latency, aggressive retrying. I told them we're routing mitigation.

jess (sre): autoscaler attempts failing with error buried in node-provisioner:
```
E 2026-06-12T03:12:34Z provisioner: request failed: quotaExceeded: Insufficient regional GPU quota (requested 16, available 0)
E 2026-06-12T03:13:01Z provisioner: instance stuck in PROVISIONING state, last transition: ImagePullBackOff
```

marco (infra): confirmed. cloud reports both quota and transient registry rate-limits for our patched image. opened cloud support ticket and bumped soft-limit request.

sara (oncall): while cloud work proceeds, let's offload inbound VelvetPay traffic to hosted fallback model variant (quantized gpt-small-q) to keep latency under SLO. need config change on routing rules.

marco (infra): updating routing policy: set `route.dedi-east-1/velvetpay -> hosted-quantized-1` as temporary override. applying now.

ops-bot: route update applied (cfg-1791999999), traffic shift starting 30s. watch for auth/perf regressions.

aliya (cs): VelvetPay confirms some requests now 200s but content okay. they're asking for ETA. I gave 45-60m for stabilization, flagged for account exec.

jess (sre): also enabling rate-based admission control for non-enterprise to reduce noisy neighbor pressure: `admission.set --pool dedi-east-1 --non-enterprise-rate 10r/s`

marco (infra): autoscaler limit temporarily increased via feature-flag to allow up to 48 GPUs while cloud quota request pending. `ff toggle autoscale-extra-capacity=true` — will revert after incident.

incident-bot: NOTE: feature-flag 'autoscale-extra-capacity' enabled by sara (oncall) at 03:28 UTC.

ops-bot: cloud support replied — quota approved but scheduling ETA ~22 minutes. registry back-off resolved after switching to cached image in our mirror. provisioning resumed.

ops-bot: provisioning progress: 4 new nodes accepted, 4/4 kernels loaded, runtime warmup complete. adding to pool.

jess (sre): good — queue length trending down, reserved latency back under 1200ms for VelvetPay. still seeing some retries from earlier clients, but error rate dropping.

sara (oncall): starting customer bridge summary for post-incident: impact = VelvetPay saw 15-20% 429s + elevated latency for ~40m; cause = regional GPU quota exhaustion + image pull throttling causing autoscaler failures; mitigations = soft-evictions, admission control, traffic routing to hosted quantized fallback, temporary autoscale flag, cloud quota bump.

aliya (cs): VelvetPay is satisfied with the workaround and asked for proactive follow-up. escalated to AM + solutions.

marco (infra): scheduling a follow-up to remove feature flag and revert routing once all nodes green. `ff toggle autoscale-extra-capacity=false` on safe window.

jess (sre): created incident ticket (INC-2026-1791999999) with timeline and metrics. adding runbook action items: improve image mirror fallback, add autoscaler retry backoff jitter, and implement per-tenant backpressure early.

sara (oncall): handing back to SRE/infra for cleanups. I'll stay on the bridge for 10m then close pager if stable. great work everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: final metrics snapshot: reserved GPU utilization peaked 100% -> 78% after mitigation, median tail latency from 4.2s -> 0.9s, queue depth from 420 -> 60.

sara (oncall): closing pager to oncall rotation at 03:45 UTC. follow-ups assigned. please file postmortem within 72h.

marco (infra): noted. I'll add convergence playbook and follow up with cloud quota team.

jess (sre): will own postmortem and runbook updates.

aliya (cs): I'll send VelvetPay a summary and invite them to review the RCA.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (status: mitigated) — last update at 1792000450
